description: A reverb built from a feedback delay network: up to sixteen delay lines fed through an orthonormal mixing matrix, with separate decay times above and below 800Hz

params.text: Delays the signal before it reaches the reverb, 1ms to 500ms, despite the maker's tooltip calling it Time
Scales the length of every delay line together, a tenth of their full length to all of it, which is what sets how big the room sounds
Sets how long a sound above 800Hz takes to fall by 60dB, half a second to 10 seconds
Sets how long a sound below 800Hz takes to fall by 60dB, half a second to 10 seconds
Sets how many delay lines the network uses, 1 to 16; more lines give a denser tail and cost more CPU
Mixes the reverb against the dry signal, all dry at the left and all reverb at the right

outputs.text: The mix of the reverb and the dry signal

notes: the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only
